hook:
think of a yes or no question.
now pick a card

piles.title: yes, a clear one
piles.text: the sun is as close to a yes as tarot gets. go ahead, and stop asking everyone else for permission.

piles.title: not yet
piles.text: the hanged man says wait. the answer isn't no, the timing just isn't here. look at it from another angle first.

piles.title: no, and it's protecting you
piles.text: the tower says this one would fall apart. it stings now, but it clears space for something that actually holds.

cta:
comment 1, 2 or 3
and your question if you're brave
caption: yes or no tarot: think of a question and pick a card 🃏 #tarot #yesornotarot #pickacard #tarotreading #tarottok
